title: Chapter 45 A Hundred Years Later, The First Encounter With The Bear Race
content:
Chapter 45 A Hundred Years Later, The First Encounter With The Bear Race

Without human race, how is this possible?

Is there no one in the world of spirits?

"Ao Qing, why is this?"

Ao Qing shook his head, "I don't know much about this. Anyway, there are indeed no human race in the world of all spirits, but there are people, but there are only a few, and there are not many decent people. indivual."

Everyone felt very uncomfortable when they heard that people were living so miserably in the world of all spirits.

"A hundred years later, the great name of the human race will resound throughout the world of all spirits."

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke slowly.

Hearing this, everyone was stunned and their blood suddenly became boiling.

It seems that the lord from the city is going to show his skills in the world of all spirits.

"Sir, what should we do?"

At this time, An Xing, who had been silent on the side, spoke respectfully.

Hearing this question, Lu Daosheng swept over everyone present and said, "In a hundred years, I have improved at least eight levels."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng used his palm to display the world, and a powerful law of time continued to permeate.

It seemed that he felt that it was not enough, Lu Daosheng spread his left hand and the Time and Space God Tower suddenly appeared in his palm.

"Change!"

Buzz —

Suddenly, the flow rate of time in the world in the palm suddenly changed drastically.

This time, the outside world has been one day and the inside world has been ten years!

Eight realms.

You should know that the later you go, the slower the speed of breaking through the realm will be and the more difficult it will be.

Now, Lu Daosheng asked them to break through eight realms in the next time. It has to be said that it is very difficult and very difficult.

But when they looked up and saw Lu Daosheng's serious and somewhat low expression, everyone suddenly felt a terrified.

"Master Lord, I will definitely succeed!"

Immediately, everyone entered the world in their palms, including Ao Qing and Ouyang Yanqing.

Above the seat, looking at the empty hall, Lu Daosheng's expression was slightly dark.

Since learning that people were not doing well in the Hongmeng Universe, Lu Daosheng has been a little uneasy.

Because my daughter is in the world of all spirits, will she suffer from frustration because of her identity as a human race?

Moreover, he is also a human race, and he feels uncomfortable if his compatriots live like that.

Therefore, it is necessary for me to do something for the human race in the world of all spirits.

.........

Somewhere in the world of all spirits.

Lu Xue woke up in a daze, but she heard the whispering sounds coming from her ears.

"Class leader, how did this summon a human?"

"Yes, patriarch, didn't you say that this ritual can summon creatures with great fortune to protect our clan?"

"I don't know much about this, this, either."

Suddenly, Lu Xue woke up a little and quickly stood up.

When Lu Xue saw this, she was stunned and saw a group of white and fluffy bears in front of her.

White bear monster!

"Captain, look! She is awake."

In an instant, all the white bears surrounded Lu Xue.

"What do you want to do?"

Lu Xue was a little panicked when she looked at these white bears.

At the same time, she was also looking at the surrounding environment and found that it was snowy and covered with snow.

At this time, the largest white bear came forward and sniffed Lu Xue.

After pondering for a while, he took out a strange cane and pointed at Lu Xue.

Seeing this, Lu Xue was puzzled.

The next moment, the cane suddenly burst out with a dazzling light, almost blinding the bears' titanium alloy dog eyes.

But with a click.

The cane was broken suddenly.

Lu Xue:?

Bears:? ?

The patriarch of the Bear Clan: My lucky stick! !

"Clan, patriarch, what's going on?"

A white bear said in confusion.

But the biggest white bear, the leader of the bear clan, had moist eyes. When he heard the tribe's question, the leader of the bear clan wiped his tears and said, "She really has great luck, and she has great luck, High enough,"

"What a taller one? Oh, patriarch, don't always talk halfway."

"Ahem."

The patriarch of the bear clan coughed lightly and then continued, "The luck of this human being seems to be higher than that of the entire world of all spirits."

Speaking of this, the head of the bear tribe looked extremely solemn.

In his opinion, this was simply impossible.

Hell.

But his luck can no longer bear the luck of this human woman and it was broken directly.

This cane is a treasure heirloom of their White Bear clan.

Unexpectedly, today was broken.

So that's the truth.

Hearing this, the bears immediately looked at Lu Xue incredible.

There were even a few white bears who stretched out their fingers and poked this human creature with great luck.

"Hey, look, she's glaring at me."

Lu Xue (angry): "Everyone will go away!"

What do you think of this? A group of white bears appeared by their side for no reason and said something they couldn't understand for no reason.

Have great luck in one's own body.

She didn't know, she only knew that she had an invincible father.

"Everything comes back."

At this time, the patriarch of the bear clan spoke.

These white bears immediately stepped aside obediently.

Immediately, the patriarch of the bear clan looked at Lu Xue and said, "I announce that you will be a member of my White Bear clan in the future."

Lu Xue:! ! !

"Hey hey hey, I haven't agreed yet!"

However, the bears ignored Lu Xue's incompetence and cheered.

"Oh yeah, my white bear tribe is going to rise!"

"Long live the tribe leader!"

"Long live!"

After a long time, in a stone house.

Lu Xue lay on the table with no desire to live, her face full of grievances.

This group of hateful stinky bears.

If I can't beat them, I will beat them into black bears and punish them all to steal cassocks.

At this time, there was a creak.

The door opened.

The tribe leader of the bear tribe walked into the house slowly.

Seeing this bear, Lu Xue snorted coldly, turned her head away, and ignored it.

However, the tribe leader of the bear tribe sat opposite Lu Xue.

"You are summoned by this tribe leader. You must lead the bear tribe to glory in the future. The future of our bear tribe is in your hands."

Hearing this sudden heavy responsibility, Lu Xue's temples were blue with veins, and he suppressed his anger.

I will endure.

If you endure for a while, everything will be calm.

Dad will definitely come to save me.

At this time, the bear tribe leader continued: "By the way, you don't have a name yet, so from now on, just call it, emm,,,"

Looking at Lu Xue's light blue clothes, she looked like a decent person, and then slowly said: "From now on, just call her Broccoli."

The more I think about it, the angrier I get! !

I can't bear it anymore, I don't need to bear it anymore! ! !

"You are Broccoli! Your whole family is Broccoli!!"

Suddenly, Lu Xue jumped directly on the head of the bear tribe leader, waving her little fists.

The damage is zero.

But it is extremely insulting.

"How dare you! I am the tribe leader,, oh, let go of my nose!!"

After a long time, Lu Xue sat down breathlessly.

The bear tribe leader was not feeling well either, covering his nose and staring at Lu Xue with resentment.

"I am the tribe leader, you have to listen to me."

Hearing this, Lu Xue spit.

"I only listen to my father."

"You, you still have a father?!"

"Ah!! I'm going to kill you!"

At this moment, a rumbling sound suddenly came from outside the house.

Suddenly, the face of the bear tribe leader changed drastically.

"Chief, it's bad, those guys are coming again!"

Then, the bear tribe leader directly pulled Lu Xue outside.

I saw that countless tiger-shaped monsters outside surrounded the entire white bear tribe.

"I'll give you one last chance, either get out or die!"

At this time, a strong tiger tribe warrior stood up and roared.

Hearing this, the white bear tribe leader said in a deep voice: "This territory was occupied by my white bear tribe first."

Hearing this, the tiger tribe sneered: "What's the use of coming first, do you have the strength?"

Suddenly, a strong breath surged out of his body.

In just a moment, all the white bears retreated one after another.

But surprisingly, Lu Xue stood there, and nothing happened.
